name: Pipeline for uploading new BRS-SRS-SDS specs to KBs

parameters.subject: ={{ '[Cognia KB] Pipeline Action Required - ' + $('Check Upload Results').first().json.currentCommit }}
parameters.text:
={{
  (() => {
    const r = $('Check Upload Results').first().json;

    const pending = r.pendingReviewDocuments ?? [];

    const pendingDetails = pending.length
      ? pending.map((doc, index) => [
          `${index + 1}. ${doc.spec_path}`,
          `   Type: ${doc.document_type}`,
          `   Operation: ${doc.operation || 'N/A'}`,
          `   Doc ID: ${doc.doc_id || 'N/A'}`,
          `   Reason: ${doc.reason || 'Not specified'}`
        ].join('\n')).join('\n\n')
      : 'None';

    return [
      'Cognia KB Pipeline - Action Required',
      '',
      'Pipeline: ' + r.pipeline_id,
      'Commit: ' + r.currentCommit,
      '',
      'Expected Documents: ' + r.expectedCount,
      'Processed Documents: ' + r.processedCount,
      'Uploaded: ' + r.uploadedCount,
      'Skipped: ' + r.skippedCount,
      'Recovered: ' + r.recoveredCount,
      'Pending Review: ' + r.pendingReviewCount,
      'Failed (including Pending Review): ' + r.failedCount,
      '',
      '=== PENDING REVIEW DOCUMENTS ===',
      pendingDetails,
      '',
      '=== MISSING DOCUMENTS ===',
      JSON.stringify(r.missingDocuments ?? [], null, 2),
      '',
      '=== UNEXPECTED DOCUMENTS ===',
      JSON.stringify(r.unexpectedDocuments ?? [], null, 2),
      '',
      '=== DUPLICATE RESULTS ===',
      JSON.stringify(r.duplicateDocuments ?? [], null, 2),
      '',
      'Tracker was NOT updated.',
      '',
      'Manual review is required.'
    ].join('\n');
  })()
}}
